title: Rant: Entity systems and the Rust borrow checker ... or something.
summary: Jonathan Blow's hour-long livestreamed response to a RustConf 2018 closing keynote about entity systems in Rust. He argues that index-based entity systems amount to manual memory management that sidesteps the borrow checker, and he talks about friction for game developers.
why: It is the standard citation in HN arguments over Rust for game development, the borrow checker and ECS designs, as a skeptical view from an experienced game developer.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: A more detailed description of his opinions are laid out here where he goes into much more detail
